description: South Korea's Hwang Seo-hyun won the gold medal in the women's balance beam event in artistic gymnastics at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Friday, bringing in the country's second title in the sport. Hwang scored 14.700 points in the women's balance beam final, beating Qiu Qiyuan of China, who earned 14.566 points, at Nagoya General Gymnasium in Nagoya, central Japan. Mana Okamura of Japan won bronze with 14.300 points. (Yonhap)
title: South Korea's Hwang Seo-hyun wins gold in women's balance beam at Asian Games

description: South Korea won a silver medal and a bronze medal in team shooting events at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Friday, raising its total in the sport to eight. Choo Ga-eun and Hong Su-hyeon won silver in the 10-meter air pistol mixed team event with 478 points at Aichi Prefectural General Shooting Gallery in Toyota, some 25 kilometers east of the main host city of Nagoya. title: South Korea earns silver, bronze in team shooting events

description: Children and tourists gathered at Namsangol Hanok Village in central Seoul on Friday for traditional Chuseok activities. Children dressed in hanbok played traditional Korean games, including “jegichagi,” which involves using the feet to keep a small pouch from touching the ground, and "tuho," in which players toss arrows into a container. The Seoul Metropolitan Government is hosting a three-day Chuseok festival, “Namsan Dalbit Madang,” at the village from Friday to Sunday.
title: Chuseok traditions come alive in Seoul
